note: Reads a variable-length encoded size field from the LATM bitstream. The size value is attacker-controlled and can exceed the 4096-byte stack buffer size.
Clamps size to available bytes in the bitstream, but does not clamp to the 4096-byte stack buffer size. If the input contains more than 4096 bytes, size remains larger than the buffer.
Writes size bytes from the bitstream into the caller-provided buffer. When buffer points to the 4096-byte stack array latm_buffer and size > 4096, this causes a stack-buffer-overflow WRITE.
Declares a 4096-byte stack buffer that will be passed to latm_dmx_sync_frame_bs as the destination for frame data.
Initializes the frame size variable to 4096, but this value is overwritten by latm_dmx_sync_frame_bs with the attacker-controlled size from the bitstream.
Calls latm_dmx_sync_frame_bs with the 4096-byte stack buffer. The function reads the attacker-controlled size field and writes that many bytes into the stack buffer, overflowing it when size > 4096.
